title: The Emojis
body:
I'm sorry but why did you guys change the emojis? Or is it just me and something's wrong with my devices. I have two Apple devices, a iPad and IPhone. I have me+ on both of them. The emojis look like Android emojis ( no offense to Android users) but I don't like how they look. Can you please change them to how
They normally looked.
author: kutieprincess101
